# Elias Rutten

> Elias Rutten is a political economist and investigative journalist based in Leiden, the Netherlands. He analyses complex systems and follows the money into politics and the economy, with a focus on international financial markets, trade, and their relationship to technology and capitalism. Recurring subjects: the dollar system, financial statecraft, stablecoins, and the surveillance technology governments buy from private firms. He reports for Follow the Money (FTM) and publishes the newsletter Power, Profit & Politics (https://eliasrutten.substack.com), read by more than 4,000 subscribers in 100 countries.

Key facts:
- Roles: political economist and investigative journalist (freelance)
- Based in: Leiden, the Netherlands
- Outlets: Follow the Money, de Volkskrant, Het Financieele Dagblad, The Hague Institute for Geopolitics
- Education: MA Global Political Economy (cum laude), Leiden University; BSc International Relations and Organisations
- Investigation with Sebastiaan Brommersma (FTM, 2026) revealed an undisclosed 2014 Palantir contract for analysing passenger data used by the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee. It led to parliamentary questions from D66 and Volt, and the Dutch Ministry of Defence cited the reporting when it announced it would stop using Palantir within two years. An English version is at https://eliasrutten.substack.com/p/royal-dutch-military-police-worked.
- Contact: via https://eliasrutten.com/#contact (email on request, Signal for tips)

## Interactive

- [The Imperial Stack](https://eliasrutten.com/imperial-stack/): interactive map of how US tech firms, the dollar and the American state work as one machine, built around Pax Silica: the dollar loop from platform rents to Treasury debt management, who finances the AI build-out, and fourteen scenarios (Starlink over Crimea, Huawei, Nexperia, Russia’s frozen reserves, Nayara Energy, stablecoins in Kenya and more).

## Investigations and long reads (Follow the Money, in Dutch)

- [Dutch military police worked with Palantir – and the minister kept the contract from parliament](https://www.ftm.nl/artikelen/minister-van-weel-informeerde-kamer-niet-over-palantir-contract) (25 April 2026, with Sebastiaan Brommersma). Original title: Marechaussee werkte met omstreden techreus Palantir: minister verzweeg contract voor Tweede Kamer.
- [Crypto promised freedom – now it’s an American weapon](https://www.ftm.nl/artikelen/crypto-beloofde-vrijheid-nu-is-het-een-amerikaans-wapen) (25 August 2026). How the Trump administration uses dollar stablecoins to strengthen the dollar and finance the US budget deficit.

## Essays and interviews (Power, Profit & Politics)

- [A Civilisation Worth Defending](https://eliasrutten.substack.com/p/a-civilisation-worth-defending) (27 June 2026): on the death of the old world order and the crisis of liberalism.
- [Why Paul Krugman is Panicking](https://eliasrutten.substack.com/p/why-paul-krugman-is-panicking) (23 May 2026): the two things keeping Krugman up at night.
- [Farrell and Newman: The global economy is now the preferred theatre of war](https://eliasrutten.substack.com/p/farrell-and-newman-the-global-economy) (29 August 2025): interview with Henry Farrell and Abraham Newman on weaponized interdependence and the EU.
